description: Verify overtime pay for a workweek in two stages: FLSA regular-rate and overtime premium computation per 29 CFR 778 (ART-340), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Federal weekly 40-hour rule only; state daily overtime rules are out of scope. Not legal advice.
name: overtime-pay-check

steps.handoff: Produces regular_rate, overtime_hours, and overtime_premium_pay via the FLSA regular-rate method; nondiscretionary bonuses are included in the rate, discretionary bonuses excluded
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Overtime Pay Check
